image_description: A close-up view of two black computer desktop speakers. The central speaker is fully visible, featuring a rectangular enclosure with rounded corners, a grey mesh grille covering the upper driver area, and a circular logo near the bottom. A second identical speaker is partially visible on the right, and a third object (possibly another speaker or subwoofer) is partially visible on the left. The image has a white background.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner of the central speaker's front face
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a small white label or print near the bottom edge. The characters are indistinct and slightly melted/blurred, failing to form legible text, which is a common AI artifact in rendering small typography.

The mesh pattern lacks consistent geometric regularity. Some areas appear slightly smudged or inconsistent in density, suggesting a minor texture generation issue rather than a physically woven material.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of the central speaker where it meets the left-most object
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the central speaker and the partial object on the left is slightly ambiguous. The shadows and edges blend together more than expected for two separate rigid plastic objects, indicating slight spatial grounding weakness.

To audit the sharpness of the edges and ensure the speaker is a single continuous rigid body without melting into the background or adjacent objects.

Geometric regularity of the mesh grille pattern
Edge sharpness and separation between the speaker and the white background
Consistency of lighting reflections on the plastic casing

Verify if the text is merely low-resolution or genuinely structurally invalid.
